caption: The image shows an intricately decorated, oval-shaped platter, viewed from above. The platter features a monochromatic color scheme in shades of gray. In the center, there are two human figures: one is standing on the left side and appears to be dressed in a hat and vest, while the other is to the right, wearing a long coat and holding an object to their face. Between the two figures, there is an ornate shield or crest, surmounted by a sailing ship with two sails, and supported on both sides by the two figures. The background of the central scene contains rolling hills, clouds, and possibly water, giving a landscape effect. The inner border around the central scene is decorated with a repeating geometric pattern, and the wide rim of the platter features a densely packed floral and leaf motif, including large leaves, blossoms, and buds arranged in clusters. The design retains a balanced symmetry along the length and width of the platter.
title: Platter - "Delaware Arms"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
